# Delete each yesterday's request and create corrected ones (amount - $5)
for req in yesterday_requests:
    rid = req["payment_request_id"]
    email = req["receiver"]["email"]
    amount = req["amount"] - 5
    description = req["description"]
    # Delete the old request
    apis.venmo.delete_payment_request(payment_request_id=rid, access_token=access_token)
    # Create new request with corrected amount

    print(f"Deleted {rid}, created new request for {email} amount {amount}")
